User Story Description: As a user, I want to register and authenticate securely so that I can access my digital wallet.
Security Acceptance Criteria: BCrypt factor 12, HMAC-SHA256 JWT, generic error messages

User Story Description: As a user, I want a digital wallet provisioned and the ability to add simulated funds so that I have a balance to make purchases.
Acceptance Criteria: Auto wallet creation with bash.00, POST /api/wallets/fund
Security Acceptance Criteria: BOLA check (owner only), balance ceiling, positive decimals

User Story Description: As a merchant, I want to register my merchant business so that I can receive customer payments.
Acceptance Criteria: POST /api/merchants registers business, creates merchant ID & wallet
Security Acceptance Criteria: Requires ROLE_USER or ROLE_MERCHANT, XSS sanitization

User Story Description: As a user, I want to initiate and confirm payments to merchants so that I can purchase simulated goods.
Acceptance Criteria: POST /api/payments creates payment, debits sender, credits merchant
Security Acceptance Criteria: Non-negative balance enforcement, atomic state FSM

User Story Description: As an administrator, I want basic transactional audit logging so that all debits and credits are recorded.
Acceptance Criteria: Audit log records created on logins and payments
Security Acceptance Criteria: Append-only audit table, sensitive token scrubbing

User Story Description: BUG: Duplicate payment accepted when idempotency key was not enforced; race condition allows double spending.
Acceptance Criteria: Carried over from Sprint 1 to Sprint 2 for comprehensive fix
Security Acceptance Criteria: Pessimistic row locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) & Idempotency key

User Story Description: As a user, I want pessimistic row locking on wallet balances so that concurrent payments cannot cause double-spending or negative balances.
Acceptance Criteria: Pessimistic write locking on DB rows during payment
Security Acceptance Criteria: Zero double spending under concurrency stress test; DB check constraint

User Story Description: As a payment gateway, I want mandatory Idempotency-Key enforcement with SHA-256 payload binding so that replayed payments return cached response.
Acceptance Criteria: Mandatory Idempotency-Key header; identical payload returns cached response
Security Acceptance Criteria: Tampered payload with reused key triggers REPLAY_DETECTED alert (409 Conflict)

User Story Description: As a merchant, I want to issue refunds on confirmed transactions so that dissatisfied customers receive their funds back.
Security Acceptance Criteria: Only merchant owner can refund; status must be CONFIRMED; duplicate refund blocked

User Story Description: As a user and merchant, I want to view my immutable transaction history ledger so that I have a complete financial audit record.
Security Acceptance Criteria: BOLA protection ensures users cannot view foreign transaction ledgers

User Story Description: As an administrator, I want to inspect security audit logs and receive alerts on replay and double-spending attempts so that fraudulent behavior is investigated.
Acceptance Criteria: GET /api/admin/audit-logs and GET /api/admin/alerts return security events
Security Acceptance Criteria: Strict ROLE_ADMIN verification; unprivileged users receive 403 Forbidden

User Story Description: As a DevSecOps engineer, I want containerized Docker images and Kubernetes manifests with non-root security contexts so that the gateway runs securely in production.
Acceptance Criteria: Multi-stage Docker build, non-root user (UID 10001), K8s manifests
Security Acceptance Criteria: Resource quotas, dropped capabilities, no baked-in secrets

User Story Description: As a QA engineer, I want automated unit, integration, concurrency, rollback, and fuzzing test suites in CI so that regressions are automatically blocked.
Acceptance Criteria: Automated test suite passing in CI; 100% pass on security test suite
Security Acceptance Criteria: Zero vulnerabilities in SonarQube SAST scan
